blocks.title: Labelling Triangles
blocks.body:
In a triangle, lowercase letters represent sides and uppercase letters represent angles.

Each side is named with the same letter as the angle **opposite** to it.

Side $a$ is opposite angle $A$. Side $b$ is opposite angle $B$. Side $c$ is opposite angle $C$.

Opposite sides and angles do not touch.

- We label a vertex (corner) of a triangle and the angle at that vertex using the same uppercase letter.

blocks.title: Identify Triangle opposite angle/side pairs
blocks.prompt: Label the missing sides/angles of these triangles.

cells.label: a
cells.answer: Side $a$ opposite angle $A$, side $b$ opposite angle $B$, side $c$ opposite angle $C$

cells.label: b
cells.answer: Side $a$ opposite angle $A$, side $b$ opposite angle $B$, side $c$ opposite angle $C$

cells.label: c
cells.answer: Side $p$ opposite angle $P$, side $q$ opposite angle $Q$, side $r$ opposite angle $R$

cells.label: d
cells.answer: Angle $A$ opposite side $a$, angle $D$ opposite side $d$, angle $R$ opposite side $r$

items.text: In a triangle, each side is named with the same {{lowercase}} letter as its opposite angle.
Side $a$ is opposite angle {{$A$}}, side {{$b$}} is opposite angle $B$.
To find which angle is opposite a side, look for the angle that the side does NOT {{touch}}.
